content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the presence of unnecessary round end data handling in the game logic, which was leading to confusion and potential errors in transitioning between game rounds. The previous implementation relied on a `RoundEndData` class to manage data after a round ended, but this was deemed unnecessary for the new mid-round loading feature. The patch removed this redundant data handling and introduced a more streamlined approach by using events to signal when all players are ready and when the server is ready, thus simplifying the game state management and preventing issues related to outdated or incorrect round end data.
